title: Efficacy and Safety of a Purified Standardised Bee Venom Preparation
brief_summary: The trial is performed to assess efficacy and safety of a purified standardised bee venom preparation in bee venom allergy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of bee venom allergy,
* Positive RAST for bee venom,
* Positive skin prick test for bee venom

Exclusion Criteria:

* Serious chronic diseases
